notes: Customer summary: mid-market product analytics SaaS; heavy in-app assistant + contextual product recommendations. Wants predictable per-route latency and clear unit economics before committing to Dedicated.

Primary evaluation path: start w/ Hosted API to validate UX and prompts, then migrate to Dedicated for predictable throughput and lower unit cost. Interested in Optimize recommendations to tune batching/caching/quantization.
POC details: simulate 20M tokens/day, ~120 concurrent req/s peak, multi-tenant routing by customer tier. Key SLOs: p95 latency <= 450ms; cost target: reduce token cost by 30-50% vs naive serving.
- Quick wins: aggressive prefix/KV caching for help & FAQ intents; cache hit target 60% reduces token throughput significantly.
- Batching profiles: a mix of small (<64 tokens) low-latency batches + background large batches for summaries; suggested dynamic batching windows tied to route SLA.

- Quantization: interested in INT8 profiles for bulk reranking and embeddings; needs validated p95 latency and quality delta for their prompts. Want per-model quantized benchmarks on their prompt set.
- Unit economics: we modeled per-token cost vs. Dedicated committed capacity; recommend a 6-9 month committed band to amortize reserved GPUs for their traffic shape.
Quote from CTO (call): 'We can tolerate small dips in quality for reranking if it halves our token bill — but p95 latency can't spike.'

Security/Compliance: require SSO/SAML + audit logs + KMS for keying customer data. Data residency: US and EU regions depending on tenant origin. On-prem not required now, but want VPC option for Dedicated.
Technical questions outstanding: exact cache TTLs recommended per intent, autoscale cold-start behavior for Dedicated pools, and quantized kernel selection for our model family (decoder-only 7B-ish).
POC success criteria: run 7-day simulated load, show 30%+ cost reduction via batching/caching/quantization without >5% drop in QA metrics and p95 < 450ms throughout.

Next tacticals: Priya to run 'batch size sensitivity' test on hosted endpoints with their sample traffic, deliver per-route cost projection. Jordan to follow up with a customised Dedicated pricing spreadsheet and contract skeleton.
Health: high technical alignment, procurement timeline the main gating item. Team excitement about Optimize-led workshop outputs.
